yui-15s.title: Yui in 15 seconds
yui-15s.what: Ask your agent a question. It answers with a screen you can tap.

yui-lines-30s.title: Yui Lines in 30 seconds
yui-lines-30s.what: One line of Yui Lines becomes a screen. 1.6x fewer tokens than minified JSON.

your-hermes-60s.title: Your Hermes on your phone in 60 seconds
your-hermes-60s.what: Install the plugin, pair, and your own Hermes agent answers on your iPhone with a screen.

film-meet-yui.title: Meet Yui
film-meet-yui.what: You asked for a timer and got an essay. In Yui, one line from your agent becomes the whole screen.

film-plan-to-launch.title: Plan to launch
film-plan-to-launch.what: One project start to finish: a pottery studio's website, from plan mode and picked photos to before and after, the reel and the timeline.

film-jam.title: Jam with your agent
film-jam.what: Music tools: a beat, your edits, a patch, chords on the circle of fifths, a solo.

film-lessons.title: A lesson is one deck
film-lessons.what: Compound interest as one deck: a diagram, the formula, a chart, a graded quiz and a calculator.

film-agents.title: Your agents, one app
film-agents.what: Every agent wears its own look. Add and pair one, @mention another, restyle Yui by asking.

film-built-in-public.title: Built in public
film-built-in-public.what: Feedback becomes a card, an agent builds it, it ships to TestFlight, and the site says so.

film-full-screen.title: Yui lives on the full screen
film-full-screen.what: One question used to get eight pages. Now the stage answers: short parts with a picture each, questions last with one Send, and the chat is the record.

film-hands-full.title: Cook with your hands full
film-hands-full.what: Flour on your hands? Tap the mic once and just talk. Your agent walks you through dinner on the whole screen, and the oven timer keeps count on your lock screen.

film-afford-it.title: Can I afford it?
film-afford-it.what: Ask out loud about the car you want. Your agent answers with one number, then a calculator you drag, the whole cost side by side, and one Send.

film-homework.title: Homework rescue
film-homework.what: Stuck on fractions at 8 pm. Your agent shows it as a picture, turns it into a memory game and a quick check, then plans tomorrow from the score.

film-tune-up.title: Tune up, keep time, send a take
film-tune-up.what: Yui 0.4.1 for musicians: a tuner on the mic, a metronome in the chat, Record sends the take to your agent as the sound and the notes, and a MIDI keyboard plays the keys.

film-new-face.title: The new face, filmed in the app
film-new-face.what: Yui 0.4.1, build 208, filmed in the app: hold the big mic and talk, one question gets one screen, parts with a picture each, one Send, the record top right, agents that move their own way, a picture that listens.

film-meet-yui-home.title: Meet Yui
film-meet-yui-home.what: One evening with Yui: talk and the words show as you say them, dinner as three recipes to tap and a timer on the lock screen, Saturday planned with one Send, Coach in its own look, then lessons, charts, games, music and timers. Your agents, on the whole screen.

film-mongols-by-map.title: History as a map that moves
film-mongols-by-map.what: Ask for the rise and fall of the Mongol Empire and drag through 160 years: the empire grows across the steppe, splits into four khanates, carries silk and then the plague along the same roads, and becomes Friday's lesson with one Send.

film-markets-2020.title: 2020, macro drawn
film-markets-2020.what: A record high, then down a third in 33 days. One agent reads prices, the Fed and the jobs report, draws the whole machine, and six linked charts move under one finger. Historical data; education, not investment advice.

film-3am-incident.title: On call at 3 am
film-3am-incident.what: Checkout is failing at 3:07 am. One agent reads the alerts, logs, metrics and last night's deploys, finds the change, and asks before it rolls anything back. One Send, and back to sleep.
